newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hosiden, Philips to set up LCD venture in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Hosiden, Philips to set up LCD venture in Japan.

text.p: Hosiden Corp said on Friday that it and a unit of Philips Electronics NV had agreed to set up a joint venture in Japan for liquid crystal display (LCD) business.

The equally owned joint venture, Hosiden and Philips Display Corp, is expected to be capitalised at 15 billion yen and will develop and produce thin-film transistor liquid crystal display (TFT-LCD) panels, Hosiden said in a statement.

Hosiden will sell its TFT-LCD business to the new firm for a price estimated at about 20 billion yen, the statement said. Hosiden's TFT-LCD operation posted a current loss of 12.1 billion yen in the 1995/96 business year that ended on March 31.
TFT-LCD panels are the most advanced display panels for personal computers and other information equipment.
